question: Ash gets 15 cents from his mother every day and 5 cents from his father every day, and he saves all of it. After 5 days he had exactly one dollar. He then spent 78 cents on a comic. His sister paid him back 12 cents. How many cents does Ash have now?

A bread recipe uses 154 grams of flour, plus 36 grams of rye flour, but the baker takes out 13 grams of flour from every loaf to keep the dough soft, and lets it rest for half an hour. She bakes 9 loaves on a tray, 3 trays in each oven load, and runs 4 oven loads. She also uses 14 grams of flour to dust the counter. How many grams of flour does she use altogether?

Tia had 84 coins in her video game and won 22 more. She checks her score twice a day. She spent 21 coins on a shield and reached level 12. At the end of the game every coin she has left is worth 9 points, and she earns a 36-point bonus for finishing. How many points does Tia score?

Kit's weekly pocket money is 239 cents. Every week he also earns 65 cents for washing the car, spends 104 cents on a comic, and gets 26 cents back from returning bottles, which leaves a little over two dollars each week. He saves this amount every week for 8 weeks. His grandfather then gives him 22 cents. How many cents has Kit saved?

In the morning a bakery had 152 buns, and the baker made 16 more, then another 8. In the afternoon a delivery brought 28 buns. In the evening half of the buns were sent to a shelter, and the rest were shared equally among the 3 staff members. How many buns did the staff member Lou take home?

Jo had 14 cents. He spent 5 cents on a sweet. His aunt gave him 69 cents, a little over half a dollar. He split his money equally between himself and his sister, so there were 2 equal shares and he kept one. He then spent 19 cents on a pencil and 8 cents on an eraser. How many cents does Jo have left?

In the morning a coach had 195 minutes booked for each training session, more than three hours, but cut 154 minutes from every session. She ran 4 sessions that morning. In the afternoon the time from the morning sessions was shared equally among 4 trainees to record on their cards. In the evening one trainee, Kay, noted that she would train exactly the same way on each of 3 days. How many minutes will Kay record for the 3 days?

A quiz night has 56 tokens in each box, and the host opened 4 boxes. She found 55 more tokens in a drawer and 31 in a bag. The hall was booked for 3 hours. All the tokens were shared equally between the 2 teams. At the end of the night every token held by the red team was worth 5 points. How many points did the red team score?

Uma had 195 minutes of talk time on her phone, more than three hours. The company added 18 bonus minutes. She made a 52-minute call to her mother and another 52-minute call to her aunt. Her friend Vic, who uses more minutes than Uma, called her for 69 minutes. Her phone is 3 years old. She then made a 29-minute call to the dentist. How many minutes of talk time does Uma have left?

A theatre sold 237 tickets on Monday, 39 on Tuesday, 20 on Wednesday, 52 on Thursday, and 3 on Friday. The theatre has 8 exits. On Saturday 12 tickets were refunded. How many tickets were sold and not refunded?

In the morning a grocer received 23 crates. Each crate held 9 boxes, and each box held 9 oranges. In the afternoon he sold 371 oranges. In the evening a farmer dropped off 63 oranges, and then a neighbour brought 11 more. How many oranges did the grocer have at the end of the evening?

In the morning Bo had 38 tomato plants in his greenhouse and sold 24 of them. He waters his plants twice a day. Each plant he kept gave him 8 tomatoes. In the afternoon his friend Cy, who had picked fewer tomatoes than Bo, gave him 34 tomatoes. In the evening Bo sold every tomato he had for 5 cents each. How many cents did Bo receive?

A school club had 134 dollars in its account and spent 29 dollars on badges. The rest was shared equally among its 5 sections. The club has 40 members. The art section spent 15 dollars on paint. A sponsor then gave the art section 3 dollars for every dollar it had left, and the section also received a 71-dollar grant. How many dollars does the art section have now?

Fay keeps her coins in a jar. She started with 39 cents, then added 70 cents from her grandmother, 38 cents from selling old comics, and 79 cents from returning bottles. She then split the money equally between 2 jars, a blue one and a red one. How many cents are in the blue jar?

A quarry loads 225 kilograms of stone in each scoop, and a truck takes 9 scoops. Each truck also carries 74 kilograms of gravel. The quarry runs 3 trucks, each making one trip a day, for 5 days, with a half-hour break at noon. The quarry is 6 kilometres from town. On the last day 52 kilograms of stone are added by hand. How many kilograms does the quarry send out altogether?

Ivy earns 123 cents an hour at the bakery, where she has worked for a dozen years. She works 5 hours a day for 7 days. The bakery opens at 6. She then spends 3482 cents on a train fare and 466 cents on lunch. How many cents does Ivy have left?

A pantry shelf held 147 jars of jam. The cook made 50 more jars and put them on the shelf. She then sold 44 jars at the fair. A neighbour gave her 40 jars, and later she found 6 jars in a cupboard and added them to the shelf. How many jars are on the shelf now?

Nell had 80 raffle tickets. She gave 22 tickets to her cousin Oz, who then had fewer tickets than Nell. She sold each of her remaining tickets for 7 cents. She spent 299 cents on lunch. At the fair every cent she had left earned her 9 points, and she then spent 929 points on a prize. How many points does Nell have left?

In the morning a bakery had 83 loaves. It sold 65 loaves, and 3 were burnt and thrown away. Each remaining loaf was cut into 3 pieces. The oven was set to 220 degrees. In the afternoon 28 pieces were sold, and a neighbouring stall sent over 53 pieces. In the evening every piece was sold for 9 cents. How many cents did the bakery take in the evening?

Pia earns 159 cents a day walking dogs and 72 cents a day feeding cats, and she saves it all. Her friend Quin, who works half as many hours, earns less each day than Pia. Pia saves like this for 3 days. She then receives 74 cents from her aunt and 22 cents from her uncle. She spends 550 cents on a lead for her own dog. How many cents does Pia have left?

In the morning Rae and Sol picked 7 rows of strawberries with 103 berries in each row. In the afternoon they picked 45 more from a wild patch. They shared all the berries equally between the 2 of them, so Rae's share was exactly the same as Sol's. In the evening Rae ate 43 of her berries. How many berries does Rae have left?

In the morning a warehouse held 28 crates, and 7 were shipped out. Then 23 crates arrived. In the afternoon the manager opened every crate and found 2 boxes in each, and every box held 5 bags. The warehouse has 6 doors. In the evening the bags were weighed at 8 kilograms each. How many kilograms did all the bags weigh?

A charity had 156 minutes of phone calls to make, more than two and a half hours, and shared the work equally among 3 volunteers. Tam received her share, and then 17 minutes of calls were added to her list. Her friend Uli finished his calls sooner than Tam. Tam spread her calls equally over 3 days. On Monday she added 59 minutes of extra calls, and then 23 minutes of her Monday calls were cancelled. How many minutes of calls did Tam make on Monday?

In the morning Van earned 67 cents an hour at the stall plus 63 cents an hour in tips, and he worked 5 hours. In the afternoon he counted that he would work exactly the same on each of 6 days, which came to thirty-nine dollars. A customer added 28 cents. In the evening he spent 3102 cents on a coat. How many cents does Van have left?

Vera earns 211 cents for each shift at the cafe and worked 4 shifts this week. She spent 502 cents on groceries. Her friend Wes, who earns less per shift than Vera, paid her back 48 cents. The cafe then gave her 8 loyalty points for every cent she had. How many loyalty points did Vera get?
